explication: Oppia is a Python/Angular learning platform for creating, sharing, and completing interactive explorations. Learners enter through the Angular router, receive lesson state and feedback from the exploration engine, and may complete question or review-test flows. Contributors use dashboard and translation workflows. The backend contains domain services, controllers, persistent models, and integrations. Sampled source confirms routing, player engines, review-test HTTP retrieval, browser storage, email dispatch, and Redis-backed storage; several backend relationships remain intentionally unconnected because their callers were not sampled.
